hooks.name: aide-story-readiness-create
hooks.description: Validate a newly created Jira story and queue specification authoring only when it is EARS-ready.

hooks.name: aide-story-readiness-save
hooks.description: Revalidate a saved Jira story and update its idempotent specification request.

hooks.name: aide-story-spec-create
hooks.description: Draft a bounded Kiro specification after creation of an EARS-ready Jira story.

action.prompt: Run `uv run --project .aide/full/hook --offline --frozen aide-hook aide-story-to-spec` and parse its JSON. If action is none, complete, or blocked, report that state and stop. For generate or repair, use only the returned story_path, spec_dir, and gaps. Follow the spec-brain skill first, then prompt/generate-kiro-specs-from-jira-story.md and the aide-spec-authoring skill. Create or repair requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md only inside spec_dir. Do not implement. Rerun aide-story-to-spec after writing; repeat only while it returns repair. The command enforces a maximum of three attempts. Stop and present Gate A when it returns complete.

hooks.name: aide-story-spec-save
hooks.description: Draft a bounded Kiro specification after an imported Jira story becomes EARS-ready.
